signal: Celigo named the only 2025 Gartner Peer Insights Customers' Choice for iPaaS and a 2026 G2 Best Software winner, with 4,000-plus customers

email.body1:
Laura, saw Celigo named the only Gartner Peer Insights Customers' Choice for iPaaS and a 2026 G2 Best Software winner, now past 4,000 customers.

Recognition like that drives more inbound and in-market accounts than strategic BD can actually touch, and that is where good-fit deals quietly stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Celigo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: a quick teardown of your outbound
email.body2:
Laura, quick follow-up for Celigo.

Strategic BD only compounds when every in-market account gets a researched, timely first touch, yet most reps lose hours to research and CRM instead of conversations. Tightening that motion is often where the easy lift hides.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent, and I will tailor it to your strategic targets.
email.body3:
Laura, last bit of proof for Celigo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Celigo's reply rate likely compares to other mid-market SaaS and iPaaS firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Laura, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling strategic BD pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. With the recognition rolling in, there is plenty competing for your attention.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a strategic BD motion? I will tailor it to Celigo either way.
